title: A Real-global equivariant Segal--Becker splitting, explicit Brauer induction, and global Adams operations
summary: We prove a splitting result in global equivariant homotopy theory that is a simultaneous refinement of the Segal--Becker splitting and its `Real' and equivariant generalizations, and of the explicit Brauer induction of Boltje and Symonds. We show that the morphism of ultra-commutative Real-global ring spectra from $Σ^\infty_+ B_{\text{gl}}U(1)$ to the Real-global K-theory spectrum that classifies the tautological Real $U(1)$-representation admits a section on underlying Real-global infinite loop spaces.
